testId: testim-migrated/tests/admin/sales-rep/sales-rep-user-association.spec.ts > Admin - Sales Rep > Z10-TC-23140 sales rep popup paginates with the right total

scenario.summary: On Manage User of a store A user, with more store A sales reps than one popup page holds, the popup shows the right total and 'showing 1-10 of N' / '1-20 of N' by page size.
steps: Accounts & Users > Users; open the store A user (@user.userName) with Manage.
Click the search icon next to Sales Rep.
Observe the pager and the total; change the page size (10, 20, 100).
stateChanges: None (the users and sales reps are created and deleted by their collections).
assertions: The total number of sales reps is right (the rows over all pages)
The pager shows 'showing 1-10 of N' at 10 per page and '1-20 of N' (or 1-N) at 20 per page
evidence: Story Z10-28590 (Stabilize Sales Rep Workflow), data-needs analysis work/stories/Z10-28590/analysis.md section 9 (group B remainder) and answers in sections 6 and 9.3.
FSD: pagination and total count in the Sales Rep popup.
More reps than a page: 11 store A sales reps (rep1..rep11), as 23071; other tests of the run may add store A reps, so the total is checked against the rows the popup lists at the largest page size.
Store MaxwellsHardware: the store the migrated suites run on (store A). Store B: STORE_WEBSTORE_ACTIVE with exceptPortalId = @storeA.portalId (any other active webstore).
Admin session: the suite's saved admin session (admin.setup.ts), a credential, not a need.
